title: The Quiet Choir of Caddock Vale

statements.text: The Quiet Choir meets each dusk in the shrine at Caddock Vale
The Choir sings the same three verses every night
Mother Ilse Brand — leads in public — the Quiet Choir
She has never refused a bowl of soup to a traveller
The children carry lanterns home at dusk, as they always have
The real direction of the Choir comes from the groundskeeper, Garrick Fenn
Ilse does not know that the verses are a key
Beneath the shrine a stair leads down past the well to a chamber with a bronze door
The Choir believes the door opens when the third verse is sung in full
Garrick learned them from a book found in the well
